entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling about an order I received a couple of weeks ago. I bought a new cycling jersey, but it's not working out for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number?
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Men's Aero Jersey, delivered 14 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size for me. I ordered my usual medium, but this one is just way too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to process an exchange for a large.
Okay, a size exchange. Let me just confirm our return policy for you.
Alright, I've checked the policy. Since the jersey was delivered 14 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get that exchange started for you right away.

That's great news. Now, since I have to go through the process of packaging this one up and sending it back, would it be possible to get a small credit or a discount code for my next purchase for the trouble?

I understand the request, but our policy for a standard size exchange is a direct one-for-one swap. I can't add a discount, but I can issue your pre-paid return label immediately to make the process as smooth as possible.
I see. Okay, no discount. What about expediting the shipping on the new size so I don't have to wait as long?

That I can do. I'll go ahead and process the exchange now, and I've upgraded the shipping on the replacement size Large to 2-day priority at no extra cost to you. The return label is on its way to your email.
Okay, that works for me. Upgraded shipping is a good solution. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
